summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing the transcript of its Half-Year 2026 Results Briefing. The transcript covers operational and financial results, including production of 86.5 million barrels of oil equivalent, EBITDA of $4.6 billion, underlying net profit of $1.3 billion, and a fully franked interim dividend of US$0.57 per share. The CEO also announced a structural cost reduction target of US$350 million per year from 2028. This is a routine earnings communication, not a special-situation event. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or board change is involved.
